product_name: Organic Apple Mango Carrot Baby Puree

allergen_requirements.rule: Product is naturally allergen-free. Allergen statement should confirm allergen-free status or state 'Contains no major food allergens'.

net_quantity_rules.rule: Dual unit declaration required on bottom 30% of PDP: '99g (3.5 oz)'.

safety_warnings.rule: Mandatory FDA infant pouch warning: 'CHOKING HAZARD: Keep cap out of reach of children under 3 years. Do not microwave pouch.'

storage_text: Store unopened at room temperature. Refrigerate within 1 hour after opening and serve within 24 hours.
